bio: Caitlin Conley (born 1985/1986) is an American politician and national security official who served 18 years in the U.S. Army. She is the Democratic member-elect for the U.S. House of Representatives in New York's 17th district after defeating incumbent Republican Mike Lawler in the 2026 election.
